newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent falls slightly, tracking NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent falls slightly, tracking NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures fell slightly on Monday during Asian hours undermined by the continued slide of NYMEX futures.
February Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $23.39 per barrel, down seven cents from London, but on just 34 lots.

On Friday the IPE shed 52 cents to end at $23.46, undermined by book squaring and Saudi comments that it would not necessarily cut production to make way for Iraq if the United Nations lifted sanctions against Baghdad.
Brokers said SIMEX was quiet and tracked NYMEX through the day.
NYMEX February crude was down 18 cents at $24.90 per barrel on the after-hours ACCESS system, after New York dropped 37 cents to $25.08. Volume was a modest 629 lots.

January heating oil continued its slide on ACCESS on demand for pipeline allocations in the U.S.. January was last traded down 0.47 cent to 72.50 cents per gallon, little changed from earlier ACCESS trading, after it had shed 0.81 cent to 72.97 in New York.
SIMEX Brent closes at 1600 local hours (0800 GMT) on Tuesday.
